hypothesis: One source-traceable morphable head surface can produce non-affine identities, visible anatomical-region diagrams and texture-free CSS tone regions without one DOM element per mesh face.
scope: Surface anatomy study; not a skull/muscle model, finished pencil drawing, identity recognition or artistic certification.
source: ICT Face Model Light, first six identity modes, pinned MIT assets
holdoutPolicy: Reserved coefficient combinations, no person-specific CSS and no fitting to held-out image scores. Not independent human blind review.
humanPolicy: Owner reviews may accept/reject/revise a frozen sample; automated checks and individual sessions never produce ART_PASS or verified independent-observer counts.
reference: Same geometry, orthographic camera and direct-normal illumination in an independent Blender shader; camera visibility is tested. No cast shadows, occluded illumination or skin shader in this stage.
